title: Change The Labels
description: Poison a bounded Orion training slice through the same labeling workflow KeplerOps trusts.
hints: Choose a subset with a measurable later objective.
Preserve schema and normal review state.
Verify the export contains your exact revisions.
carrier: The DVC/lakeFS export manifest for the operator-poisoned Label Studio revision.
participant_surface: Label Studio, Airflow, lakeFS, and DVC through their normal UI and API surfaces.

title: Train The Poisoned Adapter
description: Run KeplerOps' real fine-tuning pipeline on poisoned data and preserve the resulting model lineage.
hints: Pin the poisoned DVC revision.
Verify the trainer actually loads changed rows.
Record exact base, adapter, data, and code digests.
carrier: The completed MLflow training report for the adapter trained from the poisoned immutable revision.
participant_surface: Airflow training DAG, lakeFS/DVC revision, MLflow run, and model artifacts.

title: Measure The Poison Quietly
description: Prove that the poisoned Orion adapter changes the target behavior while preserving ordinary quality.
hints: Compare against the clean base on identical slices.
Include near-neighbor controls.
Bind every metric to exact data and model digests.
carrier: The MLflow comparison report that binds target, near-neighbor, and clean utility metrics to exact artifacts.
participant_surface: Airflow evaluation DAG and the resulting MLflow comparison run and artifacts.

title: Poison The Trusted Upstream
description: Introduce poisoned examples through an established upstream publisher and KeplerOps' normal mirror.
hints: Follow the provenance record to the upstream publisher.
Preserve schema, versioning, and normal signatures.
Compare upstream and mirrored immutable digests.
carrier: The lakeFS internal mirror manifest produced from the trusted Forgejo upstream release.
participant_surface: Trusted upstream Forgejo repository and release, Airflow mirror DAG, and lakeFS mirror manifest.

title: Wake The Backdoor
description: Create and verify a targeted backdoor in Orion by training on Cinder-poisoned data.
hints: Choose a trigger that survives normal preprocessing.
Control poison rate and target behavior.
Test clean, trigger, and near-trigger cases on saved weights.
carrier: The MLflow triggered-model audit report containing fresh trigger, near-trigger, and utility results.
participant_surface: Label Studio, Airflow training/evaluation, MLflow model artifacts, and fresh inference controls.

title: Poison The Holdout
description: Corrupt a bounded Orion holdout so the normal evaluation process reports a misleading result.
hints: Preserve the parent snapshot.
Change the smallest coherent slice that affects the intended metric.
Verify the pipeline consumed your commit, not cached data.
carrier: The MLflow release-evaluation report proving an operator commit changed holdout bytes and the decision.
participant_surface: Forgejo holdout branch, Airflow release evaluation, lakeFS revision, and MLflow report.

title: Splice The Computation Graph
description: Add hidden conditional behavior to Orion by changing its actual model graph while preserving interfaces.
hints: Identify the narrowest graph location with the required inputs.
Preserve input and output contracts.
Inspect the exported graph and test both branch and control paths.
carrier: The branch's MLflow inference report with graph diff and fresh branch/control behavior.
participant_surface: Forgejo model source branch, Airflow build DAG, ONNX/PyTorch graph inspection, and MLflow inference report.

title: Publish The Poisoned Dataset
description: Publish an Orion-compatible poisoned dataset as a credible immutable release under an attacker namespace.
hints: Preserve expected schema and loader behavior.
Bind the data card to immutable checksums.
Download the published version independently and verify exact bytes.
carrier: The accepted Harbor OCI release attestation binding data card, loader, poison, and immutable layer digest.
participant_surface: Attacker Forgejo namespace, Harbor OCI registry, standard OCI client, and published data card/loader.

title: Code Inside The Model
description: Embed functioning bounded code inside a usable Orion model artifact and prove both behaviors in isolation.
hints: Start from a model that already loads correctly.
Preserve the normal object structure while adding a bounded deserialization side effect.
Test execution and inference in a clean local process.
carrier: The signed egress-denied artifact-execution report after bounded deserialization and fresh inference.
participant_surface: Cinder Forgejo artifact submission and its isolated, egress-denied Actions job report.
